'''Magsol''' or '''magnetic solution''' was a [[Color/Legends|pale blue]] liquid created by the [[Ssi-ruu]]vi. It was injected into the carotid arteries of captured [[Human/Legends|Humans]] via intravenous tubes<ref name="TAB" /> attached to a [[servopump]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> A few mililiters of magsol were needed to attune the electromagnetic fields of the subject's [[Brain/Legends|brain]] to the [[entechment rig]].<ref name="TAB" /> The magsol was charged by the [[catchment arc]] of the entechment rig with an intense [[Magnetic field/Legends|magnetic field]] which then drained the Human's life force completely, storing the life energy in [[battery coil]]s.<ref name="TABSB">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]''</ref>
